theater: 美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞

battle.name: 阿納斯塔修斯戰爭
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞
battle.brief: 西元502至506年，薩珊王卡瓦德一世因東羅馬拒絕代付匈人債務而東進，先取狄奧多西波利斯，再於秋冬圍困阿米達。503年羅馬以五萬二千人分三師反攻卻遭挫，504年靠合圍與游騎襲擾奪回阿米達，506年十一月議和。卡面的早王朝埃及長矛不在前線，但守城矛列正是502年攻防的基本兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭的兩大交戰方是東羅馬帝國與薩珊波斯帝國。羅馬方面以皇帝阿納斯塔修斯一世為最高統帥，前線由東部邊軍的幾位高階將領分頭指揮：阿雷奧賓杜斯、帕特里修斯、希帕提烏斯各領一師，宮廷事務總長塞勒率後續援軍，埃及裔總督阿皮翁一世、科爾基斯人法雷斯曼尼斯、哥德人戈迪迪斯克魯斯與貝薩斯、隨從官查士丁等人各在其下；羅馬還得到薩拉比特人與坎達王國的阿拉伯盟友出兵。波斯方面由王中之王卡瓦德一世坐鎮中軍，統率薩珊各省總督與貴族的部隊，格洛內斯、米拉內斯、卑路斯、阿德爾古敦巴德斯、巴維先後在前線指揮；其附庸拉赫姆王國由國王蒙迪爾三世提供騎兵與沙漠縱隊。亞美尼亞是雙方拉鋸的核心：流亡王公與地方貴族在亞美尼亞與高加索之間擁兵自重，卡瓦德出兵兼併亞美尼亞，東羅馬則扶植亞美尼亞流亡勢力，兩家的指揮體系因此始終互相滲透。體制上，羅馬靠皇帝調度、固定編制與徵稅維持兵源糧餉；波斯靠諸省總督就地募兵、由王命率領，並以附庸國家的騎兵作為機動打擊力量。
countriesEn: The two principal belligerents in this war were the Eastern Roman Empire and the Sasanian Empire of Persia. On the Roman side the supreme commander was the emperor Anastasius I, with the actual fighting handed to a number of senior officers of the eastern frontier army: Areobindus, Patricius and Hypatius each led a division, while Celer, the magister officiorum, brought up the reinforcements; Apion the Egyptian, Pharesmanes the Colchian, the Goths Godidisklos and Bessas, and the asporistes Justin all served under them. The Romans also drew on Arab allies from the Sarabitai and the kingdom of Kindah. On the Persian side the king of kings Kavadh I sat in the centre of affairs, directing the contingents of the satraps and of the noble houses; Glones, Mihran, Perozes, Adergoudounbades and Bawi all commanded in the field at one time or another. The Persian client state of the Lakhmid kingdom under al-Mundhir III ibn al-Nu'man supplied cavalry and desert columns. Armenia was the hinge of the whole contest: exiled princes and local magnates raised armed bands between Armenia and the Caucasus, Kavadh moved in to annex the country, and the Romans maintained the Armenian exile faction, so that the two command systems remained interpenetrated throughout. In institutional terms the Romans sustained their men and provisions by imperial dispatch, fixed establishment and taxation; the Persians raised troops locally through the satraps, led them by royal command, and used the cavalry of their client states as the mobile striking force.
people: 阿納斯塔修斯一世（約425至518年，491年起在位）是這場戰爭真正的決策者。他出身君士坦丁堡的行政文官，早年以理財見長，即位後曾整頓紫染膏與絲織的專賣，卻從未親臨前線；長年的病弱也讓他選擇以援軍、固守與外交限縮戰爭，而不與卡瓦德全面決戰。卡瓦德一世（約415至531年）則是主動出擊的一方，他早年與兄長爭位，498至499年間靠嚈噠人的兵馬復位，因此背上沉重的債務；美索不達米亞下游的饑荒與洪水又讓他急需錢糧，於是在阿納斯塔修斯拒絕援助後揮兵東進。羅馬將領中，阿雷奧賓杜斯負責主攻尼西比斯，卻在阿帕德納受挫，並當面拒絕卡瓦德提出的萬磅黃金買和平；帕特里修斯與希帕提烏斯救援不及，在泰勒貝什梅一帶遭阿德爾古敦巴德斯擊潰；塞勒帶援軍北上，參與包圍阿米達；法雷斯曼尼斯設伏殺死了守城的波斯將軍格洛內斯；埃及人阿皮翁、科爾基斯人法雷斯曼尼斯與日後登基的查士丁都在這批將領之中，說明羅馬東軍裡同樣有大量行省背景的軍人。波斯陣營也不是鐵板一塊：與羅馬結盟的阿拉伯長老阿蘇阿德斯（阿斯瓦德）與羅馬將軍並肩進攻尼西比斯，而阿拉伯首領阿迪與亞美尼亞人穆什萊克在504年前後先後倒戈，另有君士坦丁將軍據說因對皇帝不滿而叛離，使波斯在阿米達周邊失去嚮導與徵召的依憑。
peopleEn: Anastasius I (c. 425-518, on the throne from 491) was the real decision-maker of this war. He came from the administrative civil service of Constantinople and was known above all for his financial ability; after his accession he reorganised the state monopolies on purple dye and silk, yet he never took the field in person, and his long-standing ill health led him to limit the war by reinforcements, fixed positions and negotiation rather than to risk a general confrontation with Kavadh. Kavadh I (c. 415-531) was the one who struck. He had fought his elder brother for the throne and, in 498-499, regained the crown with the military help of the Hephthalites, thereby taking on a heavy debt to the eastern power; famine and flooding in the lower Mesopotamian lands added to his need for money and grain, and when Anastasius refused to help, he marched east. Among the Roman commanders, Areobindus was to lead the attack on Nisibis but was checked at Apadna and refused Kavadh's offer of ten thousand pounds of gold for peace; Patricius and Hypatius could not join him in time and were routed by Adergoudounbades in the neighbourhood of Taylebeshme; Celer came north with reinforcements and took part in the investment of Amida; Pharesmanes ambushed and killed the Persian defender Glones. That an Egyptian, a Colchian and the future emperor Justin all served in this army shows how many provincials stood in the Roman eastern command. The Persian side was no single block either: the Arab notable Aswad fought alongside the Roman generals against Nisibis, while the Arab chief Adi and the Armenian Mushlehk defected around 504, and a general named Constantine is said to have gone over in resentment against the emperor, depriving the Persians of guides and of the means to raise men around Amida.
kits: 卡面這件早王朝埃及長矛屬於青銅時代的兵器：青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，主要用途是守城垣與支撐密集步兵方陣。502年的前線上自然沒有這種器物，但功能對應的東西俯拾皆是。東羅馬邊軍的步兵以大盾列陣，核心武器是短劍與標槍，後列配置弓弩手與輕裝矛兵；守城時，阿米達、埃德薩與達拉一線完全依賴守軍手中的矛與塔盾，以及牆頂居高臨下的射擊。薩珊步兵同樣以矛配短劍，並大量裝備角與木複合製成的弓與標槍，真正令羅馬將領頭疼的是波斯重甲騎兵，人馬皆披鎖子甲，衝鋒時以密集縱隊突進。攻城方面，波斯人把撞錘、攻城塔與配重投石機推到阿米達城牆下，羅馬守軍則靠女牆、射孔與臨時填塞的缺口抵擋。馬匹方面，波斯靠薩珊重騎、阿拉伯輕騎與科爾基斯騎兵作機動，運輸靠騾車、駱駝隊與底格里斯河船隻，羅馬的糧道以埃德薩、薩摩薩塔為樞紐。卡面長矛真正對得上的是守方姿態：早王朝的埃及人用它在城垣上排成密集橫列，把登城者擋在城門之外；502年阿米達守軍所用的也是同一套守城邏輯，只是矛頭材質從青銅換成了鐵。
kitsEn: The card's Egyptian spear belongs to the Bronze Age: a bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, used mainly to hold city walls and to support the close-order infantry phalanx. Nothing of the kind stood on the line in 502, but functionally equivalent gear was everywhere. The infantry of the Roman eastern army formed up behind large shields, their core weapons the short sword and the pilum, with bowmen and light spear-armed troops in the rear; in defence, the line of Amida, Edessa and Dara depended entirely on the spears and tower shields in the garrison's hands and on shooting from the parapet above. Persian infantry likewise combined spear and short sword and carried large numbers of composite bows and javelins, and it was the Persian armoured cavalry, horse and rider both in mail, charging in close columns, that worried the Roman commanders most. On the attack the Persians brought rams, siege towers and counterweight trebuchets against the walls of Amida, while the defenders relied on parapets, arrow slits and hastily filled breaches. Horses mattered: the Persians relied on Sasanian heavy cavalry, Arab light horse and Colchian riders for mobility, and on mule carts, camel trains and boats on the Tigris for supply, while the Roman grain route ran through Edessa and Samosata. What the card's spear really corresponds to is the defensive posture: early dynastic Egyptians ranked it in dense lines on the ramparts to hold climbers off at the gate, and the garrison of Amida in 502 followed the same logic, with only the head of the weapon changed from bronze to iron.
tactics: 502年卡瓦德的起手是奇襲而非正面攻堅：狄奧多西波利斯守備空虛、工事薄弱，波斯軍可能還得到當地人的內應，一夜之間就取下城市；同年馬蒂羅波利斯也陷落。接著他把主力壓在阿米達城下，於秋冬之交展開長圍，久攻不下便改以封鎖與消耗，等守軍斷糧。羅馬的反擊在503年5月成形：在埃德薩與薩摩薩塔集結三個師，兵分兩路，希帕提烏斯與帕特里修斯指向阿米達，阿雷奧賓杜斯與羅馬努斯及阿拉伯盟友直取卡瓦德駐紮的尼西比斯，企圖會師夾擊。計畫壞在配合：希帕提烏斯與帕特里修斯未能及時與阿雷奧賓杜斯合兵，反在阿帕德納與泰勒貝什梅之間被波斯騎兵擊潰，撤退時人馬沿崖墜落，損失極重。卡瓦德趁勢西進至康斯坦提亞與埃德薩近郊，掠取糧秣卻攻不下任何設防城，阿雷奧賓杜斯也拒絕了他用一萬磅黃金換和平的提議。羅馬的戰法隨之轉為以游騎斷其後勤：法雷斯曼尼斯率部襲擊阿米達周邊，用計殺死守將格洛內斯，切斷波斯在城內的耳目與徵召管道；匈人自高加索南下的壓力、援軍抵達與糧草枯竭，終於迫使卡瓦德撤兵。503年夏至504年，帕特里修斯在阿米達城下擊退來敵並轉為圍城，塞勒於504年晚春率援軍會合，圍城期間分兵劫掠貝特阿拉巴耶，阿雷奧賓杜斯則另行襲擊阿爾扎內內；同期倒戈者陸續出現，羅馬最終奪回阿米達。506年談判時雙方互不信任，扣押與釋放波斯官員成了和約延宕的關鍵。戰後的戰略選擇更為長遠：505年起皇帝在達拉興築大型設防城，507至508年完工，並修補埃德薩、巴特奈與阿米達的城防，試圖以縱深據點取代逐城拉鋸。
tacticsEn: Kavadh opened the campaign in 502 with a surprise rather than a frontal assault. Theodosiopolis was thinly held and its works were in poor repair, the Persian army may even have had the help of locals, and the city fell in a single night; Martyropolis fell in the same year. He then pressed his main body against Amida and opened a long investment at the turn of the autumn and winter, and when the walls did not yield he switched to blockade and attrition, waiting for the garrison to starve. The Roman counter-stroke took shape in May 503: three divisions were mustered at Edessa and Samosata and split into two columns, Hypatius and Patricius moving towards Amida while Areobindus, Romanus and the Arab allies went straight for Nisibis, where Kavadh himself had his camp, in the hope of a two-pronged pincer. The plan failed on coordination: Hypatius and Patricius could not join Areobindus in time and were destroyed by Persian horse between Apadna and Taylebeshme, the retreat down the cliffs throwing men and animals to their deaths. Kavadh pushed on west to Constantia and the neighbourhood of Edessa, taking provisions from the country but taking no fortified city, and Areobindus flatly refused his proposal to end the war for ten thousand pounds of gold. Roman tactics then turned to harrying his supply: Pharesmanes struck the neighbourhood of Amida and killed the defender Glones by a ruse, cutting the Persian ears and agents inside the city; pressure from the Huns coming down from the Caucasus, the arrival of Roman reinforcements and the failure of provisions finally drove Kavadh away. From the summer of 503 to 504 Patricius beat off the enemy at Amida and turned the attack into a siege; Celer joined in late spring 504, the besiegers raided Beth Arabaye and Areobindus struck separately at Arzanene, and as desertions multiplied the Romans at last retook Amida. In the negotiations of 506 mutual suspicion led to the detention and release of Persian officials, which held up the settlement. The longer strategic decision came afterwards: from 505 the emperor ordered a large fortified city built at Dara, finished in 507-508, while Edessa, Batnai and Amida had their defences repaired, replacing a war of attrition over individual towns with a defended depth.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處。503年5月，羅馬在埃德薩與薩摩薩塔集結的軍隊總兵力約五萬二千人，普羅科匹烏斯稱這是自363年尤利安皇帝進軍波斯以來帝國在東部邊界最大規模的一次集結，也是六世紀晚期羅馬軍最大的單次兵力部署；全軍分為三個師，統帥除阿雷奧賓杜斯、帕特里修斯、希帕提烏斯外，普羅科匹烏斯還提到第四位指揮官塞勒。阿米達城內的波斯守軍約三千人，由格洛內斯率領。卡瓦德提出的和約價碼是一萬磅黃金，被羅馬主帥當面回絕。阿米達的圍攻始於502年秋冬之交，翌年城破，羅馬於504年再度攻入；狄奧多西波利斯與馬蒂羅波利斯同在502年失守。戰爭自502年打到506年，跨四年；和約在506年11月簽訂，內容多已失傳，只知雙方約定七年和平，羅馬可能另付了若干款項，波斯既未佔有羅馬領土，也不必交納年度貢賦。達拉城於505年動工，507至508年間完工。同期史料沒有留下雙方可信的傷亡數字，這場戰爭的消耗只能從圍城時間、集結兵力與城市反覆易手三方面推斷。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few. In May 503 the Roman army mustered at Edessa and Samosata numbered about fifty-two thousand men; Procopius calls it the largest concentration the empire had assembled on its eastern frontier since the emperor Julian's campaign in Persia in 363, and the largest single deployment of the late Roman army in the sixth century. It was divided into three divisions, and besides Areobindus, Patricius and Hypatius, Procopius names a fourth commander, Celer. The Persian garrison inside Amida numbered some three thousand men under Glones. The price Kavadh put on peace was ten thousand pounds of gold, refused outright by the Roman commander in person. The siege of Amida opened in the turn of the autumn and winter of 502; the city fell the following year and was carried by the Romans again in 504. Theodosiopolis and Martyropolis were both lost in 502. The war ran from 502 to 506, four years in all; the treaty was signed in November 506, and though its terms are largely lost, it is known that seven years of peace were agreed, that the Romans probably paid some money over, and that the Persians took no Roman territory and owed no annual tribute. Work on Dara began in 505 and the city was finished in 507-508. The contemporary sources leave no reliable casualty figures, so the cost of this war can only be inferred from the length of the siege, the size of the concentration and the repeated change of hands in the frontier cities.
cause: 最深的原因是薩珊王室的財政崩潰。卡瓦德一世早年在王位爭奪中一度被兄長瓦赫坦廢黜，498至499年靠嚈噠人的介入才重掌大位，代價是向東方強國背上一筆巨額債務；偏偏底格里斯河下游近年的水位變化帶來洪水與饑荒，薩珊境內的糧食與財政同時吃緊。卡瓦德需要錢，阿納斯塔修斯一世卻不願替波斯出這筆錢。兩國舊約中羅馬每年向北方遊牧民族交付的錢，正是波斯此刻最想轉嫁的負擔；皇帝拒絕的理由是國庫同樣吃緊，也不願讓人認為羅馬在替薩珊打仗。於是卡瓦德把外交爭端變成軍事行動：502年他先取亞美尼亞，再圖美索不達米亞，把一場本可用錢解決的債務糾紛，擴成兩個帝國四年未停的邊境戰爭。更深一層的背景，是自440年以來兩國享受了六十餘年的邊境和平，一旦開打，任何一方的失敗都會牽動亞美尼亞、高加索與底格里斯河谷整條防線。
causeEn: The deepest cause was the financial collapse of the Sasanian court. Kavadh I had once been deposed by his elder brother during the struggle for the throne and only regained power in 498-499 with Hephthalite intervention, at the price of a heavy debt to the eastern power; on top of that, changes in the level of the Tigris downstream had brought flooding and famine, so that both the grain and the finances of the Persian realm were under strain at once. Kavadh needed money; Anastasius I would not pay it for him. The sums the Romans had been paying each year to the nomads of the north under the old arrangement were exactly the burden the Persians most wanted to pass on, and the emperor refused on the grounds that his own treasury was strained and that no one should think the Romans were fighting on Persia's behalf. Kavadh therefore turned a diplomatic quarrel into a military campaign: in 502 he took Armenia first and then turned on Mesopotamia, expanding a debt dispute that money could have settled into four years of unceasing frontier war between two empires. Behind that lay the deeper background: more than sixty years of frontier peace between the two states since 440, and once fighting began, a defeat on either side would have pulled the whole line in Armenia, the Caucasus and the Tigris valley into the collapse.
impact: 戰爭過後，兩個帝國的邊界回到戰前模樣，但誰都知道這樣的模樣靠不住。羅馬收回了阿米達，也守住了埃德薩與達拉，卻失去了狄奧多西波利斯與馬蒂羅波利斯這兩處東安納托利亞的前哨；波斯則坐實了對亞美尼亞大部的控制，並以尼西比斯作為可作縱深跳板的常駐據點。這場戰爭真正的產物是達拉城：505年開工、507至508年完工的大型設防城，往後半個世紀成為羅馬東境的第一道重鎮，也成了兩國互相指責違反422年邊防條約的焦點，波斯抱怨羅馬在邊境修築新工事，羅馬則以金錢平息對方的怨氣。另一層影響在戰略觀念上：阿納斯塔修斯一世以避免全面戰爭、寧取守城與談判的作風應對邊界壓力，這套取向後來被查士丁時代繼承，再經拉齊克戰爭的鍛鍊，才發展出六世紀羅馬與波斯交手的另一種樣貌。對薩珊而言，出兵兼併亞美尼亞也在境內惹來新的怨氣：亞美尼亞貴族與北方部族在戰爭中陸續倒戈，說明以武力兼併不等於收服人心。
impactEn: When it was over the frontier of the two empires had returned to its former shape, though everyone knew that shape could not be relied upon. The Romans recovered Amida and held Edessa and Dara, but lost Theodosiopolis and Martyropolis, two outposts in eastern Anatolia; the Persians confirmed their hold over most of Armenia and kept Nisibis as a permanent base from which to strike into depth. The real product of the war was the city of Dara, begun in 505 and finished in 507-508: for the next half century it stood as the first great stronghold of the Roman eastern frontier and became the standing point of mutual accusation that the Romans were breaking the frontier clauses of the treaty of 422, with Persia protesting at new works on the border and the Romans buying off the objection with money. A second effect was strategic in character: Anastasius I met pressure on the frontier by refusing a general war and preferring fortified positions and negotiation, and that approach was inherited by the age of Justinian and, after being tested in the Lazic War, developed into another form of Roman-Persian warfare in the sixth century. For Persia, the annexation of Armenia raised fresh resentment inside the empire: Armenian magnates and northern tribes deserted in the course of the war, showing that seizure by force is not the same as winning consent.
result: 打完之後，戰術上是羅馬佔優，戰略上則是平手。卡瓦德在503年攻入羅馬地盤，被羅馬主力在阿帕德納與泰勒貝什梅之間擊退，兵鋒止於埃德薩近郊；他原想用一萬磅黃金買下和平，被阿雷奧賓杜斯一口回絕；圍困阿米達的計劃也因匈人南侵、援軍抵達與糧草告急而瓦解，格洛內斯更死在法雷斯曼尼斯的計上。帕特里修斯與塞勒在504年把阿米達重新拿下，羅馬守軍重新站上城頭。真正的收尾發生在外交場合：雙方在506年因互疑而一度扣押波斯官員，談判幾乎破裂，最後仍於11月簽下條約，約定七年和平。條款細節多已不傳，可以確定的是波斯沒有佔去羅馬的領土，羅馬也不必再像先前那樣以年費換取對方的善意，據普羅科匹烏斯推想，羅馬很可能還另付了若干款項給波斯。戰後的走向也定了調：505年興建的達拉城在507至508年完工，埃德薩、巴特奈與阿米達的城防同時修補，羅馬的東境防禦從此以達拉為支點重建。
resultEn: Afterwards the Romans had the better of the tactics and the Persians held the strategic balance. In 503 Kavadh invaded Roman territory, was beaten back by the Roman main force between Apadna and Taylebeshme, and pushed no further than the neighbourhood of Edessa; he had wanted to buy peace for ten thousand pounds of gold and had it refused in his face by Areobindus; and his plan for Amida collapsed under the southern pressure of the Huns, the arrival of Roman reinforcements and the failure of his provisions, while Glones died from the ruse worked by Pharesmanes. Patricius and Celer carried Amida back in 504 and the Roman garrison stood once more on its walls. The real conclusion was reached in the diplomatic arena: mutual suspicion led in 506 to the detention of Persian officials and brought the talks close to breakdown, yet a treaty was signed in November, agreeing seven years of peace. Little of the terms survives. What is certain is that the Persians took no Roman land, that the Romans no longer had to pay the annual price for the other's goodwill as they had done before, and that Procopius supposes the Romans very likely paid the Persians a sum of money in addition. The lines of the war's future were also set: the city of Dara, begun in 505, was finished in 507-508, the defences of Edessa, Batnai and Amida were repaired at the same time, and the eastern defence of the Roman Empire was rebuilt with Dara as its pivot.
